## Comparison: `r comparison_name`


```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Guard: knit_child() evaluates this file from scripts_dir; force the working
# directory back to the report work dir so nothing is written into report/scripts/.
if (exists("main_wd") && !is.null(main_wd)) setwd(main_wd)

conditions <- strsplit(comparison_name, "_vs_")[[1]]
msstats_df <- read.csv(input_file) %>% dplyr::filter(Condition %in% conditions)

msstats_format <- FragPipetoMSstatsFormat(
  input = msstats_df,
  useUniquePeptide = TRUE,
  removeFewMeasurements = TRUE,
  removeProtein_with1Feature = FALSE,
  summaryforMultipleRows = max,
  use_log_file = TRUE,
  append = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  log_file_path = file.path(log_dir, paste0("MSstats_import_", comparison_name, ".log"))
)

summarized = dataProcess(
  msstats_format,
  logTrans = 2,
  normalization = "equalizeMedians",
  featureSubset = "topN",
  summaryMethod = "TMP",
  equalFeatureVar = TRUE,
  censoredInt = "NA",
  imputation_method = "ludovic",
  MBimpute = TRUE,
  numberOfCores = 4,
  use_log_file = TRUE,
  append = FALSE,
  log_file_path = file.path(log_dir, paste0("MSstats_preprocessing_", comparison_name, ".log"))
)
```

### PCA analysis

```{r}
# From MSstats processed data
feature_data <- summarized$FeatureLevelData

# Distribution plot
dist_plot <- ggplot(feature_data, aes(x = SUBJECT, y = ABUNDANCE, fill = GROUP)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Log2 Intensity",
    fill = "Condition",
    title = "Intensity Distribution per Sample (Post-Normalization)"
  )

# Protein matrix
protein_matrix <- summarized$ProteinLevelData %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein, SUBJECT, LogIntensities) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SUBJECT, values_from = LogIntensities) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Protein")

message(sprintf("Total proteins: %d", nrow(protein_matrix)))

# Check missingness distribution
missing_pct <- rowMeans(is.na(protein_matrix))

# Filter proteins with >30% missing
protein_filtered <- protein_matrix[missing_pct < 0.3, ]
message(sprintf("After filtering: %d proteins", nrow(protein_filtered)))

# Impute remaining NA with row minimum
protein_final <- t(apply(protein_filtered, 1, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}))

# Metadata
metadata <- summarized$ProteinLevelData %>%
  dplyr::select(SUBJECT, GROUP, SUBJECT) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Condition = GROUP, BioReplicate = SUBJECT) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$BioReplicate
metadata <- metadata[colnames(protein_final), ]

# PCA
pca_result <- pca(
  mat = protein_final,
  metadata = metadata,
  removeVar = 0.1
)

pca_plot <- biplot(pca_result, colby = "Condition", legendPosition = "right",
                   title = "PCA - Protein Level")
pca_plot
```

```{r include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-comparison differential testing.
# Helper functions and the annotation_table were sourced ONCE in the parent
# document via 05_helpers_ludovic.R, so we don't redefine anything here.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ensure we're in the report work dir before any file is written.
if (exists("main_wd") && !is.null(main_wd)) setwd(main_wd)

# Build single-row contrast matrix: condition_A = +1, condition_B = -1
contrast_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(conditions))
colnames(contrast_mat) <- conditions
rownames(contrast_mat) <- comparison_name
contrast_mat[1, conditions[1]] <-  1
contrast_mat[1, conditions[2]] <- -1

test_results <- groupComparison(contrast.matrix = contrast_mat,
                                data = summarized,
                                use_log_file = TRUE,
                                append = FALSE,
                                log_file_path = file.path(
                                  log_dir,
                                  paste0("MSstats_groupComparison_", comparison_name, ".log")))

# Annotate this single comparison using the pre-built annotation_table
annotated_df <- annotate_single_result(test_results$ComparisonResult,
                                       protein_col = "Protein")

# Export to excel file (absolute path so it lands in the report output, not scripts/)
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(annotated_df,
           file.path(main_wd, paste0("comparison_results_", comparison_name, ".xlsx")))

# Prepare per-comparison plots and summary stats
comp_results <- prepare_comparison_results(
  comparison_data = annotated_df,
  comparison_name = comparison_name,
  pvalue_cutoff   = pvalue_cutoff,
  fc_cutoff       = fc_cutoff,
  highlight_genes = highlight_genes
)
```

### Volcano Plot

The volcano plot shows the relationship between statistical significance and fold change for each protein.
```{r echo=FALSE, out.width="75%", fig.align='center', fig.height=6}
comp_results$volcano_plot
```

**Interpretation**: Points represent individual proteins. Red = upregulated, Blue = downregulated, Gray = not significant. Dashed lines indicate significance cutoffs (vertical: fold change, horizontal: adjusted p-value).

### MA Plot

The MA plot displays the relationship between mean expression level and fold change, helping identify expression-dependent biases.
```{r echo=FALSE, out.width="75%", fig.align='center', fig.height=6}
comp_results$ma_plot
```

**Interpretation**: The x-axis shows average expression level, while the y-axis shows fold change. This plot helps identify whether differential expression is biased toward highly or lowly expressed proteins. Points should be distributed symmetrically around y=0 for unbiased results.

### Summary Statistics

| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Total Proteins | `r comp_results$n_total` |
| Significantly Regulated | `r comp_results$n_sig` (`r round(comp_results$n_sig/comp_results$n_total*100, 1)`%) |
| Upregulated | `r comp_results$n_up` |
| Downregulated | `r comp_results$n_down` |

**Key findings:**

- **`r comp_results$n_up`** proteins significantly **upregulated** (adj.p < `r comp_results$pvalue_cutoff`, FC > `r comp_results$fc_cutoff`)
- **`r comp_results$n_down`** proteins significantly **downregulated** (adj.p < `r comp_results$pvalue_cutoff`, FC < `r round(1/comp_results$fc_cutoff, 2)`)

### Upregulated Proteins
```{r echo=FALSE}
if (nrow(comp_results$up_proteins) > 0) {
    DT::datatable(comp_results$up_proteins,
                  rownames = FALSE,
                  filter = 'top',
                  extensions = 'Buttons',
                  caption = paste("Upregulated Proteins in", comparison_name),
                  colnames = c("Gene_name", "Protein", "Ensembl_ID", "log2FC", "adj.pvalue", "Description"),
                  options = list(
                    pageLength = 10,
                    scrollX = FALSE,
                    dom = 'tlprfiB',
                    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf'),
                    rowCallback = JS(rowCallback)
                  )) %>%
                  formatSignif(columns = c("log2FC", "adj.pvalue"), digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("*No significantly upregulated proteins found.*\n")
}
```
